verdict.rationale: WezTerm documents a `wezterm cli` subcommand that drives a running GUI or mux instance, spawning programs and manipulating tabs and panes. A Lua event API (`wezterm.on`) is also documented. A runtime probe confirmed a fully headless control loop: daemonized mux server, then spawn, send-text, get-text and list, with no GUI needed. missing for 10: no network/HTTP API or OpenAPI spec (all OpenAPI probe paths returned 404), per-subcommand reference depth not shown in the evidence, no llms.txt or other machine-readable docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: The _cli_ subcommand interacts with a running wezterm GUI or multiplexer instance, and can be used to spawn programs and manipulate tabs and panes.
`wezterm.on` causes your specified `callback` to be called when `event_name` is emitted.
